description: Deep Frontier new-game setup of the built-in Meander map: a river looping around the central start plateau between low terraced bluffs. Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites lie on the southern bluff by the map edge and on the north-east bluff, Deep Ore Sources with Deep Drill sites beside the start and in the south-east corner, sandstone and limestone outcrops beside their pits east of the start, five Human Record Caches by the ruins, the reactor on the north-west plateau and the launch pad on the north bluff.
